agent_report.summary:
Merged PR #15 (Issue #14: day navigation and week strip) after verifying all 14 acceptance criteria against the diff, a green CI run of 21 tests, and the CI screenshot artifact at 360px and 1280px. The midnight-rollover defect named in the Issue was fixed at its root rather than patched with a timer, and Codex's external review returned no findings. The branch was behind main, so I updated it and re-waited for CI before merging; the deployed Pages site now serves the new code and returns 200.

With work in flight back to zero, I created Issue #16 (scheduled commitments with times) and labelled it ready. It is the last missing piece of the daily view and one of the five morning questions GOAL.md requires the app to answer. The body flags two things a Worker would otherwise hit: a real migration hazard where adding a commitments field to emptyDay() would make getDay return undefined for days already in a user's localStorage and throw on data they had planned (fix required in getDay, no version bump), and a warning to ignore the stale Issue #10, which covers the same feature against an abandoned planner.js architecture.

The project is not DONE: commitments, deadlines and carry-forward, weekly goals and progress, and day notes are all still absent, so several Definition of Done items have no evidence. No DONE Issue was created.
